prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Continue to Inspection", "Photo Quality Verification", "Ensure your pet's face is clear and evenly lit for the best 3D desktop render.", "Looks Great"]
1: ["Sign in with your original account to automatically restore and sync your existing pets.", "Pet Data Sync Active"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Spawn", "Generating 3D Mascot Model"]
3: ["Pet Desktop Controls Ready", "Look for your pet icon in the system tray to adjust companion visibility and controls anytime.", "Got It!"]
4: ["Meet Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Adopt, customize, and interact with your companion directly on your desktop screen."]
5: ["Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pet", "Please use the sign-in method linked to your original adoption to preserve your pet data and progress."]
6: ["Upload a Bright, High-Contrast Pet Photo", "For best mascot generation results, upload a photo with clear facial lighting and a distinct background."]
7: ["Generation usually takes 3 to 5 minutes. Feel free to minimize this window while you wait."]
8: ["Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to toggle mascot visibility or access pet controls.", "System Tray Enabled"]
9: ["Includes Free Starter Item Set"]
